Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, late 20s goddess, towering hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a towering frame with legs that seem endless, thick smooth thighs and calves, hips wide and rounded, a sharply cinched narrow waist pulled in far tighter than her bust and hips, and a full heavy bust high on her chest; her height and long legs make every curve look longer and more dramatic; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long curly ash brown hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 concentric regions around a single centre point located at the middle of her bust, about 27% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 4 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 14%, 34%, 58% and 80% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries Klimt style spirals and mosaic ornament. Her bust carries a large falcon eye on each breast, a dark-brown iris with a round black pupil that fully and opaquely covers her nipple and areola, framed by a ring of bright yellow skin and a bold black teardrop stripe, with fine slate-grey barred feathers spreading outward over the curve of her bust. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries Kandinsky style circles, triangles and sweeping lines. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries Mondrian style grid of thick lines and flat blocks. Region 4 is the ring between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo art with peonies, waves and clouds. Region 5 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries Matisse style paper cut-out leaf-like shapes. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, perfectly circular course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Her skin shows tanning oil sheen, golden bronzed glistening skin.

Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
